services.name: Competitive Cheer
services.desc: Sweet Peas is an educational gymnastics program designed to promote physical, social and cognitive development in children six months to six years old. Sweet Peas Gymnastics provides movement and sensory based activities that are fun and developmentally loaded! Our curriculum helps forge the architecture of a child's brain that will serve him or her for a lifetime. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Back handsprings, back handsprings, and MORE BACK HANDSPRINGS! This one-hour camp will be a fast-paced camp with every drill your athlete needs to make progress on doing their back handspring independently. Athletes in the beginning camp MUST have prior gymnastics, tumbling or cheer experience and be able to perform a back bend or back walkover independently. Athletes in the advanced camp should already have an emerging back handspring or be able to perform with limited help. This camp will focus on perfecting technique and connecting the back handspring with a round off.
